name: minerals-oracle-x402
description: Deterministic Web3 x402 critical raw minerals, COMEX/LME arbitrage spreads, urban-mining scrap yield oracle, and post-trade performance auditor for autonomous AI agents on Polygon.

tools.name: get_mineral_prices
tools.description: Retrieve real-time certified spot prices and multi-unit conversions (USD/troy_oz, USD/mt, USD/kg, USD/lb) for Copper, Silver, Platinum, Lithium, and Neodymium/Dysprosium with structured timestamp and source feeds.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spreads
tools.description: Calculate real-time locational basis spreads and cross-venue arbitrage yields across major global commodity exchanges (COMEX vs LME Copper, COMEX vs LBMA Silver, SMM China vs Fastmarkets Rotterdam Lithium).

tools.name: calculate_urban_mining_value
tools.description: Evaluate industrial metallurgical recycling value for physical recyclable scrap batches (EV Battery Black Mass, Auto Catalysts, E-Waste PCBs, Wind Permanent Magnets) with recovery yields, TC/RC, and payable net settlement in USDC.

tools.name: get_onchain_signed_feed
tools.description: Generate an EIP-712 cryptographically signed price feed payload and raw ABI calldata (v, r, s) for Solidity smart contracts, DeFi protocols, and AggregatorV3 consumers on Polygon.
